newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong returns to Chinese rule.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong returns to Chinese rule.

text.p: Hong Kong returned to Chinese sovereignty at midnight (1600 GMT) on Monday, ending 156 years of British rule.
Prince Charles, in a speech handing back the colony to Chinese President Jiang Zemin, thanked the people of Hong Kong on behalf of Queen Elizabeth and all of Britain.
"We shall not forget you, and we shall watch with the closest interest as you embark on this new era of your remarkable history," the prince said.

The British and Hong Kong colonial flags were lowered for the last time and the red five-star Chinese flag was raised inside the new Hong Kong Convention Centre built on land reclaimed from the harbour.
Jiang, in reply, said: "July 1, 1997, will go down in the annals of history as a day that merits eternal memory."
